senses.gloss: m.(b. h. תָּו; v. אָוָה II)mark.—Pl. תָּאוִים, תָּאוִוים.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:7">Koh. R. to XII, 7</cite> (ed. Wil. <he>תְּוָואִים</he>, fr. <cite ref="V00161"><he>תָּוָה</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="A00627"><he>אָוָה</he> II</cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18">Lev. R. s. 18</cite> <he>התחיל מתאוה תוואים וכ׳</he> he begins to mark out limits, (saying,) as far as such a place I can walk &c.; Kob. R. to XII, 5 <he>מתווה תוואים</he>.
